C1303.title: TeamPCP Exploits Stolen CI/CD Credentials to Breach Checkmarx GitHub Actions
C1303.summary: After March 19, 2026, the TeamPCP group used stolen CI/CD credentials to compromise two GitHub Actions workflows, leading to credential theft and a potential supply chain attack. The attacker achieved lateral movement and persistent access through automated pipeline tokens.

references.title: TeamPCP Hacks Checkmarx GitHub Actions Using Stolen CI Credentials
